presentation.summary: Shows every box set as a collection in a Box Sets group, kept in step with your library.
presentation.description_markdown:
Silo already groups franchise movies into box sets, with the collection's poster, backdrop and overview, but shows them only on a movie's page and in search. This plugin gives each box set a matching collection in a **Box Sets** group under the library's Collections, so franchises appear wherever collections do: the Collections tab, collection rows on Home, and Jellyfin apps.

- **No extra TMDB requests.** It reads only the box set data Silo already stores.
- **Stays in step.** After a library scan or a metadata refresh, and on its schedule, it adds and removes movies, and removes a collection once its box set no longer forms (too few movies, or box sets turned off for the library).
- **Your changes stay.** Visibility, featuring, placement and any poster or backdrop you upload are left alone. The plugin owns each collection's title, description and movies.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Turn on **Box sets** for your movie libraries in the library settings, if they are not on already.
2. In **Admin → API Keys**, create a key with no scopes for the server Owner account (or another administrator). Silo has no narrower scope for collections. Profile PINs don't matter: API keys skip them.
3. Paste the key under this plugin's **Settings**.
4. Open **Admin → Scheduled Tasks**, run **Sync box set collections** once, and give it a daily schedule. After that it also runs by itself shortly after library scans and metadata refreshes.

global_config_schema.title: Settings
global_config_schema.description: How the plugin reaches Silo's API, and where the box sets go.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: An unscoped Silo API key of the Owner or another administrator account; the plugin creates and updates collections with it. Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Group name
fields.description: The collection group box sets go in, created in each movie library that has box sets.

fields.label: Silo URL (optional)
fields.description: Only if the plugin cannot reach Silo on the address the server reports for itself, for example http://localhost:8080.

capabilities.description: Brings every movie library's box set collections in line with its box sets, looking every movie up again.
